import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', n_colors=10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Filter out NaN values and get age distribution
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna()]['AlterVHundNum']
sns.histplot(data=age_data, bins=20, kde=True, ax=ax2, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontweight='bold')
ax2.axvline(age_data.mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {age_data.mean():.1f} years')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', n_colors=len(district_counts))
ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs')
ax3.set_title('Dog Population by District', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=8)

# 4. Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create cross-tabulation of owner gender and dog gender
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'])
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='white', width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Gender')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Gender', fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', loc='upper right')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# Add some statistics as text
total_dogs = df['AnzHunde'].sum()
unique_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].nunique()
fig.text(0.5, -0.02, f'Total Registrations: {len(df):,} | Total Dogs: {total_dogs:,} | Unique Breeds: {unique_breeds}', 
         ha='center', fontsize=11, style='italic', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='lightgray', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
